t: The equations of two adjacent sides of a rhombus are y = x and y = 7x. The diagonals of the rhombus intersect each other at the point (1, 2). Then the area of the rhombus is:
e: M is mid point of diagonal AC so, vertex C = (2, 4) Eq. of line AM = y - 0 = 2(x - 0) => y = 2x … (i) y = 2x is perp to the line DB, m_1 = 2 , m_1m_2 = -1 => m_2 = -1/2 y = -(1)/(2)x + C => 2 = -(1)/(2) × 1 + C => C = (5)/(2) y = -(1)/(2)x + (5)/(2) => 2y + x = 5 … (ii) B is the intersection point of AB and DB AB => y = x , DB => 2y + x = 5 Solve eqn, 3x = 5 => x = (5)/(3), y = (5)/(3) Similarly, we find ‘D’ point (-(1)/(3), (7)/(3)) Using distance formula, AM = √(5) unit, DB = (2√(5))/(3) Area of Rhombus = area ∆ ABD + area ∆ DCB = (1)/(2) × √(5) × (2√(5))/(3) × 2 = (10)/(3)
h: एक समचतुर्भुज की दो सन्निकट भुजाओं के समीकरण y = x तथा y = 7x हैं। समचतुर्भुज के विकर्ण एक-दूसरे को बिंदु (1, 2) पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं। समचतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?

t: Which of the following line passes through the midpoint of line segment joining points (3,4) and (-2,7)?
e:
According to the mid-point formula (x, y) coordinates of mid- point
x = (3 +(-2)) /2 = 0.5
y = (4 + 7)/2 = 5.5
So, line passing through mid-point must satisfy its equation for given set of values.
According to option (1)
5.5 = 10 - (9 x 0.5) = 5.5
LHS = RHS hence line passes through mid-point.
According to option (2)
5.5 = 3 + (5 x 0.5) = 5.5
LHS = RHS hence line passes through mid-point.
According to option (3)
5.5 = 5 - (2 x 0.5) = 4
LHS is not equal to RHS hence line does not pass through mid-point.
Hence correct answer is option (4).
h: निम्न में से कौन सी रेखा जुड़ाव बिन्दुओं (3,4) और (-2,7) के रेखा खंड के मध्य बिंदु से होकर गुजरती है?

t: Find the area of the quadrilateral formed with the vertices (4, 2), (12, 5), (9, 1), and (1, -1).
e: Let the points be A(4, 2), B(12, 5), C(9, 1), and D(1, -1). The quadrilateral ABCD can be divided into triangles ABC and ACD and hence the area of the quadrilateral is the sum of the areas of the two triangles. Area of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2) and (x3, y3) is: Hence, area of the triangle ABC with vertices A(4, 2), B(12, 5) and C(9, 1) And area of the triangle ACD with vertices A(4, 2), C(9, 1), and D(1, -1). Therefore, area of the quadrilateral = 11.5 + 9 = 20.5 square units

t: What is the area (in sq.units)of the triangular region enclosed by the graphs of the equations 2x - 5y = 10, 3x + 4y = 38 and y-axis?
e: Three equations are: 2x - 5y = 10..(i) 3x + 4y = 38..(ii) And, x = 0..(iii) From (i) and (ii), we get x = (10 + 5y)/2 = (38 - 4y)/3 y = 2, x = (10 + 5 * 2)/2 = 10 From (i) and (iii), we get x = 0 2 * 0 - 5y = 10 y = -2 And, from (ii) and (iii), we get x = 0 3 * 0 + 4y = 38 y = 19/2 Then, coordinates of triangular region are (0, -2), (0, 19/2) and (10, 2) Therefore, area of the triangular region = (1/2)|0 * ((19/2) - 2) + 0 * (2 - (-2)) + 10 * (-2 - 19/2)| = 57.5 sq.units
h: समीकरण 2x - 5y = 10, 3x + 4y = 38 और y-अक्ष के आरेखों से परिबद्ध त्रिभुजाकार क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल (वर्ग इकाई में) कितना है?

t: The graphs of equations x - 3y = 5 and 2x - 4y - 6 = 0 intersect at P(x<sub>1</sub>,y<sub>1</sub>) and graph of x - 2y + 8 = 0 intersects the y-axis at Q(x<sub>2</sub>,y<sub>2</sub>). Find the value of x<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> + x<sub>2</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>2</sub><sup>2</sup>.
e:
x - 3y = 5 .. (1)
2x - 4y - 6 = 0 .. (2)
If (1) and (2) intersect at P(x<sub>1</sub>,y<sub>1</sub>), then P must satisfy both equations.
Hence,
x<sub>1</sub> - 3y<sub>1</sub> = 5 .. (3)
2x<sub>1</sub> - 4y<sub>1</sub> - 6 = 0 .. (4)
Solve (3) and (4), we get;
x<sub>1</sub> = -1 and y<sub>1</sub> = -2
x - 2y + 8 = 0 intersect the y-axis at Q(x<sub>2</sub>,y<sub>2</sub>).
At y-axis x = 0
Hence, x<sub>2</sub> = 0
Hence, (0,y<sub>2</sub>) must satisfy the equation x - 2y = -8.
0 - 2y<sub>2</sub> = -8
y<sub>2</sub> = 4
Therefore, x<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> + x<sub>2</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>2</sub><sup>2</sup> = (-1)<sup>2</sup> + (0)<sup>2</sup> - (-2)<sup>2</sup> - 4<sup>2</sup>
= 1 + 0 - 4 - 16
= -19
h: समीकरणों x - 3y = 5 और 2x - 4y - 6 = 0 के ग्राफ P(x<sub>1</sub>,y<sub>1</sub>) पर प्रतिच्छेदित करते हैं और x - 2y + 8 = 0 का ग्राफ y-अक्ष को Q(x<sub>2</sub>,y<sub>2</sub>) पर प्रतिच्छेदित करता है। x<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> + x<sub>2</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> - y<sub>2</sub><sup>2 </sup>का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: If in a parallelogram ABDC, the coordinates of A, B, and C are respectively (1, 2), (3, 4), and (2, 5), then the equation of the diagonal AD is:
h: यदि एक समांतर चतुर्भुज ABDC में, A, B और C के निर्देशांक क्रमशः (1, 2), (3, 4) और (2, 5) हों, तो विकर्ण AD का समीकरण क्या है?

t: The lines 3x + 7y = -2 and 4x - y = 18 have a unique solution. Find the distance (in units) between the unique solution and the point of intersection of the line 4x - y = 18 and the y - axis.
e:
Since, the lines 3x + 7y = -2 and 4x - y = 18 have a unique solution.
4x - y = 18 => y = 4x - 18
3x + 7y = -2
3x + 7(4x - 18) = -2
3x + 28x - 126 = -2
31x = 124
x = 4
y = -2
(x<sub>1</sub>, y<sub>1</sub>) = (4, -2)
Since, the point where line cut y-axis is the point where x = 0
4*0 - y = 18
Y = -18
Point = (x<sub>2</sub>, y<sub>2</sub>) = (0, -18)
Distance = √[(x<sub>2</sub> - x<sub>1</sub>)<sup>2</sup> + (y<sub>2</sub> - y<sub>1</sub>)<sup>2</sup>]
= √[(0 - 4)<sup>2</sup> + {-18 - (-2)}<sup>2</sup>]
= √(16 + 256)
= √272
= 4√17 cm
h: रेखाएँ 3x + 7y = -2 और 4x - y = 18 का एक अद्वितीय हल है। अद्वितीय हल और रेखा 4x - y = 18 और y - अक्ष के प्रतिच्छेद बिंदु के बीच की दूरी (इकाइयों में) ज्ञात करें।

t: If length of portion of straight line 18x + ky = 180 intercepted between axis is 5√13 unit, then find the value of 'k'.
e:
Given equation of line: 18x + ky = 180
Intercept form of equation of line: (18x/180) + (ky/180) = 1
(x/10) + [y/(180/k)] = 1
After comparing the above equation with standard intercept form of a libe: x/a + y/b = 1
a = 10, b = 180/k
Length of portion of straight line intercepted between axis = √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>)
5√13 = √[10<sup>2</sup> + (180/k)<sup>2</sup>]
325 - 100 = (180/k)<sup>2</sup>
15<sup>2</sup> = (180/k)<sup>2</sup>
15 = 180/k
k = 180/15
k = 12
h: यदि सीधी रेखा 18x + ky = 180 के अक्षों के बीच अंतःखंडित भाग की लंबाई 5√13 इकाई है, तो 'k' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The equation of a straight line passing through (1, 2) and perpendicular to the line 3x + 4y = 7 is:
e:
Given line, 3x + 4y = 7
Or y = -3x/4 + 7/4
Comparing this equation with y = mx + c, m = -3/4
The slope of the line perpendicular to this line, m1 = -1/m = 4/3
The equation of a line passing through (x1, x2) and a slope of m is given by the formula (y - y1) = m(x - x1).
The equation of the line passing through (1, 2) and as slope of 4/3 is:
(y - 2) = 4/3 * (x - 1)
So, 4x - 3y + 2 = 0

t: A circle has a radius of 6√3 units and its center lies on the line Y = X - 1. Find the equation of the circle if it passes through (12, 7).
e:
Center = X<sub>1</sub>, Y<sub>1</sub>
Y<sub>1</sub> = X<sub>1</sub> - 1
Center = (X<sub>1</sub>, X<sub>1 </sub> - 1)
(X<sub>1</sub> - X<sub>2</sub>)<sup>2</sup> + (X<sub>1</sub> - Y<sub>2</sub>)<sup>2</sup> = Radius<sup>2</sup>
(X<sub>1</sub> - 12)<sup>2 </sup>+ (X<sub>1</sub> - 1 - 7)<sup>2</sup> = (6√3)<sup>2</sup>
X<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> + 144 - 24X<sub>1</sub> + X<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> + 64 - 16X<sub>1</sub> = 108
2X<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> - 40X<sub>1</sub> + 208 = 108
X<sub>1</sub><sup>2</sup> - 20X<sub>1</sub> + 100 = 0
X<sub>1</sub> = 10, 10
Y<sub>1</sub> = 9, 9
X1, Y1 = (9, 9)
Hence, the required equation:
(X - 9)<sup>2</sup> + (Y - 9)<sup>2</sup> = (√108)2
X<sup>2</sup> + 81 - 18X + Y<sup>2</sup> + 81 - 18Y = 108
X<sup>2</sup> + Y<sup>2</sup> - 18X - 18Y + 54 = 0
h: एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या 6√3 इकाई है और इसका केंद्र रेखा Y = X - 1 पर स्थित है। यदि वृत्त (12, 7) से होकर जाता है तो वृत्त का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: What is the length of intercepts of line 12x - 28y + 21 = 0 between two axes?
e:
12x - 28y + 21 = 0
12x - 28y = -21
(12x/-21) - (28y/-21) = 1
(4x/-7) + (4y/3) = 1
[x/(-7/4)] + [y/(3/4)] = 1
Intercept of line of the form (x/a) + (y/b) = 1 at x and y axes is 'a' and 'b' respectively.
Length of intercept = √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>)
Intercept of given line at x and y axes is '-7/4' and '3/4' respectively.
Length of intercept = √[(-7/4)<sup>2</sup> + (3/4)<sup>2</sup>] = √58/4 unit
h: दो अक्षों के बीच रेखा 12x - 28y + 21 = 0 के अंतःखंडों की लंबाई क्या है?

t: Point P is at an equal distance from the three vertices of a triangle with coordinates X (0, 0), Y (6, 0), and Z (0, 4). What are the coordinates of point P?
e: P → Circumcentre (Intersection of perpendicular bisectors) A = midpoint. of XY = (0+6)/2,(0+0)/2 = (3, 0) Slope of XY = (0-0)/(0-6) = 0 Equation of ⊥ bisector of XY: x = 3 C = midpoint. of XZ = (0+0)/2,(0+4)/2 = (0, 2) Slope of XZ = (4-0)/(0-0) = ∞ Equation of ⊥ bisector of XZ: y = 2 P = intersection of both lines P = (3, 2)
h: बिंदु P त्रिभुज के तीनों शीर्षों से समान दूरी पर है, जिनके निर्देशांक X (0, 0), Y (6, 0), और Z (0, 4) हैं। बिंदु P के निर्देशांक क्या हैं?
eh: P → परिमध्यबिंदु (लंब छेदों का प्रतिच्छेद) A = XY का मध्यबिंदु = (0+6)/2, (0+0)/2 = (3, 0) XY का ढाल = (0-0)/(0-6) = 0 XY के लंब छेद की समीकरण: x = 3 C = XZ का मध्यबिंदु = (0+0)/2, (0+4)/2 = (0, 2) XZ का ढाल = (4-0)/(0-0) = ∞ XZ के लंब छेद की समीकरण: y = 2 P = दोनों रेखाओं का प्रतिच्छेद P = (3, 2)

t: Find the coordinates of the point which divides the join of (4, -1) and (-2, -3) in the ratio 1 : 3?
e:
Given A=(4,-1) and B= (-2,-3)
x<sub>1</sub>=4,y=-1,x<sub>2</sub>=-2 and y<sub>2</sub>=-3
m<sub>1</sub>=1 and m<sub>2</sub>=3
The co-ordinates of the point which divides the line joining the co-ordinates in the ratio is found using the following formula:
x=(m<sub>1</sub> x<sub>2</sub>+m<sub>2</sub> x<sub>1</sub>)/(m<sub>1</sub>+m<sub>2</sub>)=((1 X -2)+(3 X 4))/(1+3)=10/4=5/2
y=(m<sub>1</sub> y<sub>2</sub>+m<sub>2</sub> y<sub>1</sub>)/(m<sub>1</sub>+m<sub>2</sub>)=((1 X -3)+(3 X -1))/(1+3)=(-6)/4=(-3)/2
h: उन बिन्दुओं के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिये जो (4, -1) और (-2, -3) के संधि को 1 : 3 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है ?

t: If the points (2a, a), (a, 2a), and (a, a) enclose a triangle of area 72 square units, then the coordinates of the centroid of the triangle may be:
e: (a, a) subtracted from each co-ordinate of vertices of triangle for shifting the triangle. Area of triangle = (1)/(2) × b × h = 72 => (a^2)/(2) = 72 => a = 12 Centroid of triangle = ((x_1+x_2+x_3)/(3), (y_1+y_2+y_3)/(3)) = ((4a)/(3), (4a)/(3)) = ((4 × 12)/(3), (4 × 12)/(3)) = (16, 16)
h: यदि बिंदु (2a, a), (a, 2a) तथा (a, a) एक त्रिभुज बनाते हैं जिसका क्षेत्रफल 72 वर्ग इकाई है, तो त्रिभुज के केंद्रक (centroid) के निर्देशांक क्या हो सकते हैं?

t: What is the area of the region created by the two linear equations 2x + y = 6 and 2x - y = -2 bounded by these lines and the x-axis?
e: 2x + y = 6 2x - y = -2 => 4x = 4 => x = 1 => 2 × 1 + y = 6 => y = 4 for 2x + y = 6 => 2x + 0 = 6 => x = 3 for 2x - y = -2 => 2x - 0 = -2 => x = -1 Base length = 3 - (-1) = 4 unit Height = 4 unit (y is value of intersection point) Area = (1)/(2) × 4 × 4 = 8 sqr. unit
h: रैखिक समीकरण 2x + y = 6 तथा 2x - y = -2 द्वारा तथा x-अक्ष से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?

t: The point (4, 1) undergoes the following two successive transformations: (i) Reflection about the line y = x (ii) Translation through a distance 2 units along the positive x-axis. Then the final coordinates of the point are:
e: Point (4, 1) (i) Reflection about y = x : Hence, putting coordinates of point A gives y = 4, x = 1 => The point becomes (1, 4). (ii) Translation through distance of 2 units in positive x-axis => New point becomes A(1+2, 4) = (3, 4)
h: बिंदु (4, 1) पर निम्नलिखित दो क्रमिक रूपांतरण किए जाते हैं: (i) रेखा y = x के सापेक्ष परावर्तन (ii) धनात्मक x-अक्ष की दिशा में 2 इकाई का स्थानांतरण। तो बिंदु के अंतिम निर्देशांक हैं:

t: What is the circumference of the circle having end points of the diameter are (3,4) and (-11,4)?
e:
As end points of the diameter are given,
Distance between these two end points is the length of the diameter.
Hence,
Diameter = √((3-(-11)<sup>2</sup>+(4-4)<sup>2</sup>)
= √(196+0) =14 units.
Circumference = π x Diameter = (22/7) x 14 = 44 units.
h: एक वृत जिसके व्यास का के अंतिम बिंदु (3,4) और (-11,4), उसकी परिधि क्या होगी?

t: If the line 2x + y = k passes through the point which divides the line segment joining the points (1, 1) and (2, 4) in the ratio 3:2, then the value of k is:
h: यदि रेखा 2x + y = k उस बिंदु से होकर गुजरती है जो बिंदुओं (1, 1) और (2, 4) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखंड को 3:2 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है, तो k का मान क्या है?

t: What is the reflection of the point (4, 2) on the X - axis?
e: Since, the point (4, 2) is in the first quadrant and the reflection is on X - axis. So, the reflection of this point will be in the fourth quadrant. Reflection of the point (4, 2) on the X - axis = (4, -2)
h: X-अक्ष पर बिंदु (4, 2) का प्रतिबिंब क्या है?

t: The equation of the base of an equilateral triangle is x + y = 2 and the vertex is (2, -1). The length of the side of the triangle is:
h: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज के आधार का समीकरण x + y = 2 है तथा उसका एक शीर्ष (2, -1) है। त्रिभुज की भुजा की लंबाई क्या है?

t: In triangle PQR, if the Euler line is vertical and passes through (3,0),(3,4), and (3,8), which point is the centroid?
e:
Euler’s line passes through: Orthocenter (H), Centroid (а), Circumcenter (0) Centroid divides the line joining Orthocenter and Circumcenter in 2:1.
H G O
(3,0) (3,4) (3,8)
(3,4) is the point ie. Centroid.
h: त्रिभुज PQR में, यदि यूलर रेखा ऊर्ध्वाधर है और बिंदुओं (3,0), (3,4) तथा (3,8) से होकर गुजरती है, तो इनमें से कौन-सा बिंदु केंद्रक है?
eh:
यूलर रेखा इन बिंदुओं से होकर गुज़रती है: लंबकेंद्र (H), केंद्रक (G), परिकेंद्र (O)। केंद्रक, लंबकेंद्र और परिकेंद्र को मिलाने वाली रेखा को 2:1 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है।
H G O
(3,0) (3,4) (3,8)
(3,4) वह बिंदु है, यानी केंद्रक।

t: Find the length of the part of the straight line 12x + 35y = 420 intercepted between the axes.
e:
Straight line => 12x + 35y = 420
12x/420 + 35y/420 = 1
x/35 + y/12 = 1
Comparing with x/a + y/b = 1
a = 35, b = 12
Length of the line segment = √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>)
= √(35<sup>2</sup> + 12<sup>2</sup>)
= √(1225 + 144)
= √1369
= 37 units
h: सीधी रेखा 12x + 35y = 420 के अक्षों के बीच अंतःखंडित भाग की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: In triangle ABC, if the orthocenter is (2,-3) and the circumcenter is (4,5), find the centroid.
e:
Let Orthocentre be H, Centroid be G, & Circumcentre be O.
By Euler's formula → H ──(2:1)──→ G ──→ O
H → (2, −3) ; O = (4, 5)
Let G be (x₁, y₁)
⇒ G(x₁, y₁) = ((2×4 + 2×1)/3,(2×5 - 3×1)/3)
(10/3,7/3)
h: त्रिभुज ABC में, यदि लंबकेंद्र (2,-3) और परिकेंद्र (4,5) है, तो केंद्रक ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: What are the coordinates of the point common to the lines 2x - 3y = 1 and x + 3y = 14?
e:
Linear equations:
2x - 3y = 1 -------(1)
x + 3y = 14 ----(2)
Adding both equations -
3x = 15 => x = 5
Putting the value of x in eqn(2) -
5 + 3y = 14
3y = 9

t: Which line is not parallel to the line 8x-4y=12?
e: 8x − 4y = 12 ←→ ax + by = c Here, Slope = −a/b = −8/−4 = 2 ⇒ Line parallel to the line must have slope = 2 Answer = Option (3) y=3x−1 Slope = 3 ⇒ not parallel
h: कौन सी रेखा रेखा 8x-4y=12 के समानांतर नहीं है?
eh:
8x − 4y = 12 ←→ ax + by = c
यहाँ, ढलान = −a/b = −8/−4 = 2
⇒ उस रेखा के समानांतर रेखा का ढलान = 2 होना चाहिए
उत्तर = विकल्प (3) y=3x−1
ढलान = 3 ⇒ समानांतर नहीं

t: For a triangle with vertices P(0, 0), Q(8, 0), and R(0, 16), where is its Orthocenter located?
e: In a right triangle, the orthocenter is at the vertex of the right angle. Here, triangle is right angled at P Orthocentre of △PQR = P = (0, 0)
h: एक त्रिभुज जिसके शीर्ष P(0, 0), Q(8, 0) और R(0, 16) हैं, उसका लंबकेंद्र कहाँ स्थित है?
eh: एक समकोण त्रिभुज में, लंबकेंद्र समकोण वाले शीर्ष पर होता है। यहाँ, त्रिभुज P में समकोण है △PQR का लंबकेंद्र = P = (0, 0)

t: Find the coordinates of the points where the graph 57x - 19y = 399 cuts the coordinate axes.

t: On line segment PQ, point R is placed such that PR = RQ and coordinates of P, Q, R are (-2, A), (B,6) and (-5,5) respectively. What is the product of A and B?
e:
As per given information
R(-5,5) is the mid-point of P(-2, A) and Q(B,6)
-5 = (-2 +B)/2
B =-8
5 = (A +6)/2
A =4
Product of A and B = -32
h: रेखा खंड PQ पर, बिंदु R इस प्रकार अंकित है कि PR = RQ तथा (-2, A), (B, 6) और (-5,5) क्रमश: P, Q, R के निर्देशांक हैं । Aऔर B का गुणनफल क्या है?

t: The Incenter of a triangle is located at (4, 5). The length of the altitude from the Incenter to side AB is 3 units. What is the radius of the triangle's incircle?
e: Incentre = (4, 5), altitude from incentre = 3 Radius of Incircle = Length of altitude from Incentre = 3
h: एक त्रिभुज का अंतःकेंद्र (4, 5) पर स्थित है। अंतःकेंद्र से भुजा AB पर डाले गए शीर्षलंब की लंबाई 3 इकाई है। त्रिभुज के अंतःवृत्त की त्रिज्या क्या है?
eh: अंतःकेंद्र = (4, 5), अंतःकेंद्र से ऊँचाई = 3 इन्सर्कल का त्रिज्या = अंतःकेंद्र से ऊँचाई की लंबाई = 3

t: Find the x-intercept of 4x - 8y = 16.
e:
4x − 8y = 16
Divide by 16:
⇒ x/4 - y/2 = 1 ←→ x/a+y/b = 1
x-intercept = 4 ; y-intercept = −2 i.e. (4, 0)
h: 4x - 8y = 16 का x-अंतःखंड ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A land plot is defined by points P(0,0), Q(8,0), R(9,5), S(1,5). What is the area of the parallelogram representing this plot?
e: Area of Parallelogram = Base × Height Base = √(0² + 8²) = 8 Ht. = √(0² + 5²) = 5 ⇒ Area = 8 × 5 = 40
h: एक भूखंड को बिंदुओं P(0,0), Q(8,0), R(9,5), S(1,5) द्वारा परिभाषित किया गया है। इस भूखंड का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
eh: समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल = आधार × ऊँचाई आधार = √(0² + 8²) = 8 ऊँचाई = √(0² + 5²) = 5 ⇒ क्षेत्रफल = 8 × 5 = 40

t: If a line has x-intercept 6 and y-intercept -3, what is its equation in standard form?

t: Find the equation of the sphere having centre (2, -1, 4) and the radius of 5 units.
e:
Points of centre = (x<sub>0</sub>, y<sub>0</sub>, z<sub>0</sub>) = (2, -1, 4)
Radius = R = 5 units
General equation of sphere =>
(x - x<sub>0</sub>)<sup>2</sup> + (y - y<sub>0</sub>)<sup>2</sup> +(z - z<sub>0</sub>)<sup>2</sup> = R<sup>2</sup>
(x - 2)<sup>2</sup> + [y - (-1)]<sup>2</sup> +(z - 4)<sup>2</sup> = 5<sup>2</sup>
x<sup>2</sup> + 4 - 4x + y<sup>2</sup> + 1 + 2y + z<sup>2</sup> + 16 - 8z = 25
x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + z<sup>2</sup> - 4x + 2y - 8z - 4 = 0
h: केंद्र (2, -1, 4) और 5 इकाई त्रिज्या वाले गोले का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
